<!-- All news items below this line -->
;Armed conflicts and attacks
*An explosion in [[Deir al-Balah]], [[Gaza Strip|Gaza]], kills six [[Palestinian people|Palestinians]]. [[Hamas]] and the [[Israel Defense Forces]] both deny responsibility and blame each other for the blast. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-middle-east-44017662 (BBC)]
*The [[Israeli Air Force]] used a "hotline" to issue an urgent warning to Khemeymim Airbase in Syria when a [[Russia]]n [[fighter jet]] strayed close to [[Israel]]i airspace near the [[Golan Heights]]. Last year a Syrian warplane was shot down in a similar incident. [https://www.almasdarnews.com/article/israel-almost-shot-down-russian-jet-in-syria-report/ (AMN)]
;Disasters and accidents
*An earthquake strikes a coal mine near [[Jastrzębie-Zdrój]], [[Poland]]; [[search and rescue|rescuers]] have thus far recovered two miners alive and located a third, while four remain unaccounted for. [http://www.cbc.ca/news/world/poland-coal-mine-earthquake-1.4650102 (CBC)]
*Two coal mines collapse in [[Balochistan, Pakistan]]. A gas explosion triggered one collapse, in [[Pir Ismail]], [[Marwar]], killing sixteen. A second collapse near [[Quetta]] kills two more with five miners missing. [https://tribune.com.pk/story/1703104/1-least-two-killed-several-missing-coal-mines-collapse-balochistan/ (''The Express Tribune'')]
*The [[Federal Aviation Administration]] of the [[United States]] orders [[Boeing 787]] jets using [[Rolls-Royce Trent 1000]] engines to operate within one hour of an airport at all times following safety concerns with the engines worldwide which culminated in [[Air New Zealand]] and [[Air China]] grounding their fleets last week. [https://www.telegraph.co.uk/news/2018/05/05/ba-virgin-planes-warned-stay-within-hour-airport-amid-engine/?li_source=LI&li_medium=li-recommendation-widget (''The Telegraph'')]


;Law and crime
*[[2017–2018 Russian protests]]
**Russian police detain about 1,600 anti-government protesters, including opposition leader [[Alexei Navalny]]. [https://www.rte.ie/news/world/2018/0505/960499-russia-navalny-protests/ (RTÉ)]
*[[Terrorism in England]]
**Naa'imur Zakariyah Rahman, from [[London]], formally denies an [[ISIL]] plot to murder [[Theresa May]]. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/uk-44005042 (BBC)]
*[[Egypt]]'s [[Court of Cassation]] rejects appeals by 45 people handed long prison terms over a 2013 [[Port Said]] riot that killed 42. The riots broke out in response to [[death sentence]]s handed out over a previous riot in 2012 that killed 72 [[association football|football]] fans. [http://www.xinhuanet.com/english/2018-05/06/c_137158463.htm (Xinhua)]

;Politics and elections
*[[Protests against Emmanuel Macron]]
**Thousands of people in central [[Paris]] demonstrate in an anti-Macron protest against his sweeping reforms. 2,000 security forces are deployed. [http://www.abc.net.au/news/2018-05-06/france-protests-in-paris-over-emmanuel-macron/9732292 (ABC)]

;Science and technology
*[[Exploration of Mars]]
**[[National Aeronautics and Space Administration|NASA]]'s [[InSight]] Mars lander launches from [[Vandenberg Air Force Base]] near [[Lompoc, California]]. It is the first interplanetary mission launched from the West Coast of the [[United States]]. [https://www.cbsnews.com/news/nasa-launches-insight-lander-toward-red-planet/ (CBS News)]

;Sports
*[[2018 Kentucky Derby]]
**Pre-race favorite [[Justify (horse)|Justify]] wins the [[Kentucky Derby]], becoming the first horse since [[1882 Kentucky Derby|1882]] to win the race while unraced as a two-year-old. The race was run under the wettest conditions in its history; by post time, more than {{convert|2.8|in|cm}} of rain had fallen on race day, breaking a record that had lasted since [[1918 Kentucky Derby|1918]]. [http://fox41blogs.typepad.com/wdrb_weather/2018/05/not-done-yet-more-showers-and-storms-tonight-.html (WDRB – weather)] [https://www.cbssports.com/general/news/kentucky-derby-2018-results-winner-justify-pulls-away-on-back-stretch-to-beat-apollo-curse/ (CBS Sports)]
